philosophy: One launcher (./pfy). Local OpenAI-compat inference starts first (llama-swap / llama-server, Shimmy, Ollama); harnesses attach.

harnesses.name: llama-swap
harnesses.summary: On-demand llama-server (or other OpenAI backends) hot-swap; preferred tok/s path
harnesses.setup: install llama-swap + llama-server; point config at GGUF; pfy start uses LOCAL_OPENAI_BASE_URL
harnesses.issue_stub: Complete llama-swap adapter: health + default model in ./pfy start

harnesses.name: llama.cpp llama-server
harnesses.summary: Raw llama.cpp HTTP server; one model until swapped

harnesses.name: Shimmy
harnesses.summary: Tiny Rust OpenAI-compat server; FREE forever; auto-discovers GGUF
harnesses.setup: install shimmy; it auto-finds Ollama/HF/LM Studio models
harnesses.issue_stub: Detect Shimmy :11435; keep as candidate not required

harnesses.name: Ollama
harnesses.summary: Local model server; first-class adapter, not the only spine
harnesses.setup: install ollama; ollama serve; pull models via pfy models pull
harnesses.issue_stub: Complete Ollama adapter: serve + pull + health in ./pfy start

harnesses.name: Grok Build / CLI
